name: PassPass Events
author: jeandhuart

sections.description:
PassPass Events allows you to easily integrate your PassPass events directly into your WordPress site. Display your events with a modern and customizable design, manage their visibility, and provide an optimal user experience for your visitors.

Key Features:

  • Event Display: Automatic integration via PassPass API
  • Multiple Layouts: Grid, list, or minimal display
  • Complete Customization: Colors, fonts, card styles
  • Visibility Management: Hide/show events from admin panel
  • Responsive Design: Automatic adaptation to all screen sizes
  • Custom CSS: Add your own styles with absolute priority
  • Adaptive Themes: Automatic support for light/dark themes
  • Integrated Analytics: Click tracking and statistics
  • Smart Cache: Optimized performance with caching

Easy to Use:

  1. Configure your PassPass Organization ID
  2. Use the [passpass_events] shortcode wherever you want
  3. Customize the appearance from the administration interface

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to function properly. Here’s what data is sent and when:

PassPass API (https://api.passpass.be/)
* Purpose: Retrieve your event information for display on your website
* Data sent: Your PassPass Organization ID (configured in plugin settings)
* When: Every time events are displayed on your site (cached for 15 minutes by default)
* Privacy Policy: https://passpass.be/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://passpass.be/terms

Firebase Storage (firebasestorage.googleapis.com)
* Purpose: Load event images hosted on PassPass’s image storage service
* Data sent: No personal data – only loads public event images
* When: When displaying events that contain images
* Privacy Policy: https://firebase.google.com/policies/privacy

Support

For any questions or technical support, contact us via:
* Website: https://pro.passpass.be
* Email: contact@passpass.be

Additional Info

This plugin connects to PassPass services to retrieve your events. No personal data is transmitted, only public events are displayed.

Service used: https://api.passpass.be
Privacy policy: https://pro.passpass.be/politique-de-confidentialite/
sections.installation:
1. Download and activate the plugin
  2. Go to “PassPass Events” in your administration menu
  3. Configure your Organization ID PassPass (required)
  4. Customize the appearance according to your needs
  5. Use the [passpass_events] shortcode in your pages/posts

Required Configuration:
* A PassPass account with created events
* Your PassPass Organization ID
sections.faq:
Where can I find my PassPass Organization ID?

Log in to your PassPass dashboard at https://pro.passpass.be and retrieve your Organization ID from your account settings.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, PassPass Events is completely free and will always remain so.

Can I customize the appearance?

Absolutely! The plugin offers many customization options: colors, fonts, card styles, layouts, and even custom CSS.

Do events update automatically?

Yes, events are automatically synchronized with your PassPass account. An intelligent cache system ensures optimal performance.

Can I hide certain events?

Yes, you can manage the visibility of each event individually from the administration interface.
